t: Crockford on JavaScript - Section 8: Programming Style & Your Brain

q.x: "We could not program without our gut. I have absolutely no evidence to justify that statement. But my gut tells me it's true, so I believe it." [link]

desc: In this keynote talk from YUIConf 2011, Yahoo! JavaScript architect Douglas Crockford drops some science to explain why code style is important in programming -- particularly in JavaScript -- and how tools like JSLint can help.
